bundle: Arc 4 production-lane evidence review for jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp#398
purpose: Conservative synthesis of retained production-lane experiments plus a complete two-lane replay of the generated suite, with all claim-bearing data and provenance.

terms: report rank 0, ordered top-k, membership and exact ties separately
new production-lane comparison, not a rerun of the certification candidate

integrity.independent_second_gate: evidence/full-suite-replay/harness/compare_lanes.py is a read-only reproducer for the supplemental replay, not the release gate; verify_package.py is the release gate.
integrity.verifier_coverage: verify_package.py prints, on every successful run, the set it recomputes from raw records, the set it only cross-checks between documents, and the set it does not cover. This package does not claim that every published figure is recomputed.

full_suite_replay.role: Supplemental scorer-level replay of every frozen generated query vector at the pinned release. Not the requested deliverable; see comparison_v2 for that.

disagreement_mechanism.note: First differing pair only. 83 of the 114 disagreements change more than two top-100 positions.

full_suite_replay.claim_ceiling: A within-suite rate for mechanically generated queries over three fixed corpora on one host. Not a production rate. Compares the scoring lane, not a complete tool response, and establishes no answer-quality direction.

mechanism_census.note: Derived from the three frozen corpus databases, which are outside the publication boundary. verify_package.py does not check it and no decision-facing claim rests on it.

adversarial_falsification.role: Constructed sensitivity testing plus generated-text screening and complete replay of nominated cases.
adversarial_falsification.claim_ceiling: No production rate, safety probability, or answer-quality direction can be inferred. The screen's miss rate, unknown when this packet was written, is now measured in evidence/full-suite-replay.

comparison_v1.role: Supplemental precursor retained for provenance and diagnostic value.

comparison_v2.role: The requested deliverable: the v1.108.228 two-production-lane comparison accepted in issue 398 comment 5177953577, measuring complete tool responses on 12 fixed ranking problems.

guarded_candidate.role: Separately published research-candidate evidence supporting exact boundary checks as one available control. It is not official-release performance evidence.
guarded_candidate.version_caveat: Measured 16 releases before the 1.108.228 pinned by every other strand here.

suite_overlap.note: comparison_v1, comparison_v2 and guarded_candidate cover the same 12 corpus and query-form problems over the same three corpora. They are three views of one fixed suite, not three independent suites.

evidence_hierarchy: requested deliverable: evidence/comparison-v2, the v1.108.228 two-production-lane comparison on 12 fixed ranking problems
supplemental breadth: evidence/full-suite-replay, a scorer-level replay of 5,000 mechanically generated query vectors
possibility tests: evidence/adversarial-falsification, synthetic and geometric sensitivity cases
hypotheses and follow-ups: evidence/full-suite-replay/mechanism-census.json, attested rather than gated
provenance only: evidence/comparison-v1, evidence/severity-assessment, rejected attempts, retained historical verifiers
